title: TATA: A Multilingual Table-to-Text Dataset for African Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing model performance (understandability, attribution, and reasoning) in a table-to-text generation task across nine different languages, specifically measuring the performance disparities and zero-shot cross-lingual transfer capabilities between high-resource languages (e.g., English) and under-represented African languages (e.g., Hausa, Igbo, Swahili, and Yorùbá).
